changes.result: ZaiReader::transcript_page(principal_id, chat_id) projects the current ordered native batch window to TranscriptPage. The fixture-backed test preserves node_id, instance_id, exact chat ID, both message IDs, input/output block types, and text. No native continuation cursor or history-completeness signal was observed; page.truncated=true and next_cursor=None. evidence/V093A-green.txt records the focused pass; acceptance/contracts/z-ai.md documents this limitation.

progress_events.note: Delta review: include canonical node+instance+chat, trusted principal and account scope in a length-delimited snapshot hash. Transcript block provenance must retain actual native content_blocks types/indices; omit untyped flattened content instead of inventing types. Do not start V093B.

changes.result: ZaiReader::transcript_page projects the current ordered native batch window while preserving node/instance/chat identity, provider message IDs, native content_blocks types and indices, and message-level content as text with source_field=content and no fabricated native type/index. Source implementation: a3f95ac9 (transcript projection) plus scoped completion f7355c53bd31228fcfd88c6482743a0e04462e00 (only crates/herder/src/adapters/zai/mod.rs and acceptance/contracts/z-ai.md). Focused test `cargo test --manifest-path crates/herder/Cargo.toml transcript_projection_preserves_native_block_types_indices_and_known_limits`: 1 passed, 0 failed; exact output evidence/V093A-post-projection-green.txt (SHA-256 42bd4d420976b7a9857f1e6ed81091818574bd0142d5c8b013d92f27ae1bd602). Limitation: current read is capped at the last 180 history IDs; no native continuation cursor or complete-history signal was observed, so truncated=true and next_cursor=None; full history is not claimed. Node/instance/chat snapshot digest uses canonical identity, principal, account scope, and selected payload with length-delimited fields. No live read or pagination completeness is claimed; V093B remains dependent on V030.
